title: Bangkitan Epileptik

key_points: Epileptic seizure: transient signs/symptoms from abnormal excessive neuronal activity in the brain (ILAE)
ILAE 2017 classification divides seizures into focal, generalized, and unknown onset
Reflex seizures are triggered by specific stimuli (visual, auditory, somatosensory, motor)
Frontal lobe seizures: motor cortex-based (tonic, clonic, myoclonic), supplementary motor area involvement, bizarre gestural automatisms, shorter post-ictal state
Temporal lobe seizures: visceral aura, psychic phenomena (deja vu, jamais vu), oroalimentary automatism, longer post-ictal confusion

sections.title: Definisi dan Klasifikasi

content.text: An epileptic seizure is the transient occurrence of signs and/or symptoms due to abnormal excessive or synchronous neuronal activity in the brain (ILAE). The ILAE 2017 classification organizes epilepsies by seizure type: Focal Onset (seizures originating in one hemisphere, with or without impaired awareness), Generalized Onset (seizures involving both hemispheres from onset, including motor and non-motor types), and Unknown Onset (when onset cannot be determined).
Bangkitan epilepsi: tanda/gejala sesaat akibat aktivitas neuronal abnormal dan berlebihan di otak
Klasifikasi ILAE 2017: berdasarkan onset (fokal, generalisasi, tidak diketahui)

sections.title: Klasifikasi Tipe Bangkitan

content.text: Seizures are classified by their pattern of onset and clinical manifestations. Focal seizures may spread to become bilateral tonic-clonic. Awareness (previously called consciousness) is a key distinguishing feature within focal seizures. Generalized seizures include tonic-clonic, absence, myoclonic, tonic, and atonic types.
Fokal: dengan atau tanpa gangguan kesadaran, dapat berkembang menjadi bilateral tonik-klonik
Generalisasi: tonik-klonik, absen, mioklonik, tonik, atonik

sections.title: Bangkitan Refleks dan Pemeriksaan Penunjang

content.text: Reflex seizures are triggered by specific stimuli including visual (flashing lights, patterns), auditory, somatosensory, and somatomotor triggers. Ancillary testing for epilepsy evaluation includes neuroimaging (CT/MRI), laboratory tests, CSF analysis, EEG, and EKG (to rule out cardiac causes of syncope).
Bangkitan refleks: dipicu stimulasi visual, auditorik, somatosensitif, somatomotor
Pemeriksaan penunjang: pencitraan, laboratorium, analisa LCS, EEG, EKG

sections.title: Sindroma Epilepsi - Lokalisasi Lobus

content.text: Clinical semiology provides critical localizing information for seizure origin. Each lobe produces characteristic features.
Ictal vomiting lateralizes to the RIGHT hemisphere; Post-ictal nose rubbing ipsilateral to seizure focus
